name: Social Login
author: Krafton
description: Secure Google authentication and extensible social account login for KARPy CMS.

settings.title: Social Login
settings.description: Configure secure Google sign-in and social account registration.

fields.label: Enable social login
fields.description: Show configured social providers on supported login screens.

fields.label: Google App ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Web application client ID from Google Cloud Console.

required_if.message: The social login google app id field is required when social login google enable is 1.

fields.label: Google App Secret
fields.description: OAuth client secret. Never expose this value in frontend code.

required_if.message: The social login google app secret field is required when social login google enable is 1.

fields.label: Allow new user registration
fields.description: When disabled, only an existing CMS user with the same verified email can sign in.
